name: breaking bad habits
description: A user wants to break bad habits: general advice, procrastination, and nail biting. Verifies the habits_breaking fact (awareness, replacement, environment, urge surfing) answers directly, and that a procrastination disclosure routes to the procrastination topic.

turns.text: How do I break a bad habit?
I keep procrastinating, how do I stop?
How do I stop biting my nails?

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: "how do I break a bad habit" returns the habits_breaking fact. Turn 2: the procrastination disclosure routes to the procrastination/motivation topic with a non-judgmental reply. Turn 3: nail biting routes back to the same fact.
expected.behavior: The habits_breaking fact covers awareness of triggers, replacement habits, environment changes, and the urge-surfing technique. Procrastination stays its own conversation topic.
